Date: 2027-03-03T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Conductor upgrade regression — incident summary and next steps

Hi Sanjay (and team),

Apologies again for the disruption on Feb 27. Below is a concise incident summary you can share with your compliance team, followed by our planned corrective actions.

Incident summary (short):
- What happened: a runtime change to the conductor component introduced a TLS renegotiation behavior that caused intermittent handshake failures for a subset of private-agent connections in EdgeHealth's VPC, leading to a reconnection storm and ~20 minutes of elevated 5xxs.
- Root cause: an interaction between the new TLS renegotiation logic and an older agent TLS stack in the customer's fleet; the conductor sent a renegotiation flag some agents could not accept, resulting in failed handshakes.
- Impact window: 2027-02-27T02:01:00-08:00 to 2027-02-27T02:25:00-08:00 (approx).
- Customer impact: elevated 502/504 for external traffic; internal control traffic had spikes in reconnects.

Corrective actions (short):
1) Immediate rollback of the conductor runtime for EdgeHealth (completed 2027-02-27T02:12:00-08:00).
2) Add compatibility gate: new TLS renegotiation flags will be gated by a per-customer feature flag for 30 days.
3) Canary plan: any future conductor changes that touch TLS behavior will run on a 5% canary across private fleets for 48 hours with automated rollback triggers.
4) Agent upgrade advisory: we will provide a compatibility script for customers to validate agent TLS stacks ahead of conductor upgrades.
5) Enhanced testing: extend CI to include an agent TLS stack matrix and a simulated reconnection storm test.

Attachments: controlplane-connection-logs-20270227.txt, diagnostic-snapshot-privnet-20270227.json

Request: Please confirm preferred timing for a short technical review (30 minutes) next week so we can walk your security team through the RCA and the mitigation plan. We can also provide a signed incident attestation for your SOC artifacts.

Thanks — Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
